items.title: OpenAI will show visual ads in ChatGPT while you generate images

items.lede: OpenAI's latest ad format will put images of sponsored products and services on your screen. The ads, which OpenAI will begin testing in the US later this month, will "initially" appear when you generate images with ChatGPT, according to an announcement on Monday.
